Attached: 1 image

I've been working on a rootless Linux process sandbox in pure Rust (rsb-sandbox). It talks directly to the kernel — clone3 namespaces, Landlock (ABI v1-v6), a custom Seccomp-BPF compiler, Cgroups v2, OverlayFS CoW, and a userspace smoltcp TAP bridge for DNS/TLS SNI filtering without MITM.
Ships as a Rust crate, static musl CLI, and C/Python FFI. Not a VM, just Linux kernel primitives.
https://github.com/Shura5860/rust-sandbox
https://crates.io/crates/rsb-sandbox
